description: Replace one agent skill by its id. This replaces the skill rather than patching it, so send the title, description and skill text you want it to end up with.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

description.description: What the skill is for (max 1024 characters).

skill.description: The instruction text the agent follows (max 20000 characters).

title.description: Short name for the skill (max 64 characters).

name: mba_update_agent_skill
title: Update an agent skill
